meta.description:
A crooked two-storey witch's cottage centered on a broad herbal kitchen of timber, stone, and hanging greenery. A cramped stair passage climbs into a low, candlelit attic study
    crowded with books, charms, and celestial instruments.

    crowded with books, charms, and celestial instruments.

rooms.name: The Hearthroot Kitchen
rooms.style: A broad herbal kitchen with rough oak worktables, a swollen stone hearth, copper vessels, drying plants, potion bottles, and root bundles suspended from dark ceiling beams. Furnish it with rounded, handmade forms in mossy wood, soot-dark stone, tarnished copper, and cloudy glass.

rooms.name: The Crooked Stair
rooms.style: A narrow enclosed stair passage squeezed beside the kitchen, built from uneven dark timber steps with a rope handrail, tiny wall niches, and bunches of protective herbs. Its steep vertical forms should feel improvised, worn, and slightly claustrophobic.

rooms.name: The Candlewick Attic
rooms.style: A low candlelit attic study beneath heavy rafters, furnished with a writing desk, leaning bookshelves, wax-dripping candle clusters, star charts, spell components, and a brass viewing instrument. Use dusty timber, aged parchment, deep violet cloth, and warm pools of candlelight to create an intimate scholarly refuge.
